SUMMARY The Department of Animal Services (Department), with the assistance of the City Administrative Officer (CAO), was instructed to report to Council on the costs needed to invest in large transport vehicles and personnel, including potential funding sources, to expand the Department’s ability to host and participate in more Pet Fair events throughout the City of Los Angeles, including potential participation in community resource fairs, health fairs, and other City-sponsored events. DISCUSSION The inclusion of a mobile pet adoption vehicle to Department operations would expand the Department’s ability to conduct off-site adoption and outreach events across the City of Los Angeles, vastly expanding current Department reach and community exposure. With relatively low staffing requirements and the ability to transport up to 12 animals, the use of such vehicles represents a "Creating a Humane LA" AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER Visit our website at www.LAAnimalServices.com SUBJECT: CF NO. 25-1221 - DEPARTMENT OF ANIMAL SERVICES REPORT ON THE COSTS NEEDED TO INVEST IN LARGE TRANSPORT VEHICLES AND PERSONNEL TO EXPAND THE DEPARTMENT’S ABILITY TO PARTICIPATE IN MORE EVENTS THROUGHOUT THE CITY scalable investment in increasing adoption rates and community engagement. At present, the Department does not have an available funding source nor sufficient funds to purchase a vehicle as described.
